summary: Validate exploration files from the command line without opening Copilot. Check explicit files or a project folder for supported formats, malformed graphs, duplicate identities, conflict markers and size limits. Files stay unchanged; an opt-in CI example helps teams validate pull requests.

Inspect a project journey’s local save and Git status without changing it. See private drafts separately from untracked, ignored, staged, modified and committed files, plus branch and local upstream counts. Remote freshness stays explicitly unknown; refresh preserves your editor and pending work.

Review project files changed by Git or another writer before continuing. Reload keeps incoming files untouched, preserves prior local history and exact private drafts, and rejects stale AI results. You can also preserve the displayed version privately when a project file is missing or conflicted.

Save a reviewed project copy of a personal exploration. Preview the exact file, choose whether to include question research, and continue in the copy only when ready. Originals and private drafts stay put; retries recognize identical copies and changed destinations are never overwritten.

Find shared journeys in the new Current project library. Refresh a selected folder, see individual file errors and duplicate warnings, and reopen journeys in your current canvas. Pins and recent openings stay private, with stale selections and incomplete scans clearly identified.

Create explorations in your project repository or personal library. Reopen shared files by relative path, with private drafts, history and AI usage kept separate. Project saves verify the active checkout; Journey details shows where the file lives and how to share it through Git.

Added project-storage foundations that keep shared journeys separate from private drafts, helper records, locks and recovery history. Includes clone isolation, interrupted-save recovery and safe local-history cleanup. Project storage controls will follow separately.

Added the shared exploration format foundation: exact text preservation, stable content identities, deterministic edits, and safe preparation of personal-file conversion. Repository storage remains a separate step.

Added a source-backed research architecture comparison and six reproducible decision scenarios. Documents existing-material explanations, approved URLs and web research as separate policy choices, with the owner decision still pending. Current research permissions and runtime remain unchanged.

Documented the current research experience, verified the installed plugin version, and mapped usability gaps to the redesign backlog. Includes a repeatable question-to-answer checklist and clearly separates automated evidence from pending native and live-research checks.

Question tools now open in a full-width drawer below the map, with Explore, Research, Answer details and Context tabs. Expand for more room or close it to focus on writing. Save & continue saves your answer and opens an existing next question without generating. Voice preferences stay in Settings; drafts survive drawer and tab changes.

Compact cards reserve a footer for branch buttons and status, keeping question and answer lines clear at every zoom level. Review labels have stronger contrast. Voice feedback follows the answer box. Short panes use a compact heading and scroll when banners leave too little space, keeping Save and Question tools reachable.

Simpler question cards keep the answer, Record, Save and Explore deeper up front. Expand one bottom Question tools shelf for state, cleanup, reminders, context and research. A global Settings gear holds voice, map, keyboard and local-data preferences. Drafts, caret and tool edits survive toggles; request status and new previews reveal their controls.

Answer first in expandable cards, with Save and answer state always within reach. Save and Ctrl/Command+Enter no longer start follow-up questions; Explore deeper does. Compact File/Tools menus and optional context/reminders free room in narrow panes. Typing stays anchored, question text is selectable, and keyboard focus survives menu and branch navigation.

Dictation resumes after a suspended page returns, with saved transcript chunks and continued polling. History previews now report changes to pinned constraints. Mark a reviewed structural direction explicitly in Map or Outline without changing answers, descendant review flags or local drafts.

Open a local Usage dashboard for map distributions, saved answer states, depth and branching, observed visits and question growth, and retained helper outcomes/model usage. UTC filters, accessible charts and tables, bounded scans, explicit missing-data coverage and protected observation retention preserve your editor and drafts.

Work in an optional Outline view using the same answer, research and status editor. Browse folded hierarchies or search all nodes in bounded pages, reveal selected sources, and return to the expanding map without losing drafts or camera. Minimap work pauses while hidden; pointer view switches retain active dictation.

Open Commands for existing actions and bounded local journey or node search. Keyboard navigation, private draft opt-in and an optional conflict-aware shortcut preserve your editor. Helper actions keep their review steps; stale results cannot bypass draft or source checks. Matching snippets now retain hits after long whitespace.

Combine saved state, research, review, answer drafts, importance and reminders in Outline or local library node search. See bounded matching snippets and result pages, with explicit archived scope and private draft-text opt-in. Search preserves editors and rejects stale source navigation; incomplete library coverage is shown.

Show an optional minimap below the canvas to see the current viewport, selected question and folded or focused branches. Click, drag or use arrow keys to navigate without changing answers or zoom. Hide it to reclaim space; the choice lasts for this canvas. Narrow panes now keep schematic recovery guidance visible.

Map detail adapts to zoom: distant summaries show labels, status, importance and branch counts; closer cards show questions and answers. Extreme Fit becomes a schematic overview with full Outline access. The same expanded editor stays readable while zooming, preserving drafts, caret, reminders and dictation.

Request one optional next question using current goal and constraint word matches, unresolved states and historical importance. See the reasons, open its source or dismiss without model calls or map changes. Deferred and needs-review questions stay separate; stale sources lose actions and drafts remain intact. Offline-export copy now describes included historical importance.

Generated questions can include Low, Medium or High importance with a concise historical model explanation. See compact labels, inspect reasons, and combine importance, text and reminder filters in Outline. Legacy questions stay Unranked. Validated assessments survive previews, History, native/Markdown exports and selected portable/offline exports without changing answers or certainty.

Set local-calendar review dates and manual revisit conditions on questions. Find due, overdue and acknowledged reminders in the Library and question list, including archived journeys. Acknowledge, reschedule or clear with History while preserving answers and certainty. Conditions stay user-evaluated; no monitoring, notifications or calendar writes. Native and Markdown exports retain reminders.

Share a read-only offline HTML viewer after previewing exact selected nodes, saved answers and research. Search and navigate without Copilot or the plugin, preserve uncertainty and source provenance, and open sources only by deliberate clicks. Private metadata and excluded nodes stay out; selected text is not redacted. Size limits and stale-preview checks protect the export.

Export whole journeys or selected branches as Mermaid, JSON Canvas, standalone SVG or a printable HTML map with a manual Save as PDF path. Preserve saved roles, answers, states and relationships regardless of folds or focus, with explicit size limits and private-data exclusions. Complete native and Markdown exports remain available; handoff guidance and source links are corrected.

Create a reviewed implementation brief, specification, plan, prompt or task list from explicitly selected saved decisions. Preview exact input with optional recorded research evidence, preserve uncertainty and constraints, edit and accept before copying or exporting. Project files and earlier AI artifacts stay excluded; selected-source changes require regeneration.

Ground an explicit Challenge Review in up to five selected project text files. Preview bounded Unicode excerpts, relative source names and hashes before sending; refresh changed files explicitly. Keep files out of web research, other helpers, saved journeys and exports. Reveal original quoted project sources in transient findings; native helper logs may retain model input.

Inspect local storage by category and preview old unnamed history versions before explicitly removing them. Preserve journeys, drafts, checkpoints, undo, usage and recovery evidence. Save a preview preference without automatic deletion, see partial inventory and per-file outcomes, and retry only the exact captured candidates after failures.

Challenge selected saved answers with a deliberate tool-free review. Inspect exact context and omissions before starting, then review assumptions, counterarguments, alternatives and evidence gaps with original input links. Keep drafts and decisions unchanged, dismiss findings locally, and retain separately attributed usage with cancellation and source freshness checks.

Compare saved research options in an accessible matrix. Choose criteria and personal Low, Normal or High priorities, inspect exact duplicate values and unknown cells without invented scores or citation support, and add selected details to an editable draft with undo. Comparison choices stay local to the panel; saved answers still require an explicit save.

Ask scoped follow-ups about a research recommendation or hypothetical assumption. Review exact bounded context, keep original research and saved answers unchanged, and inspect prior versus newly read evidence. Retain a small canvas-local history with explicit omissions, freshness checks, cancellation and separately attributed usage receipts.

Inspect selected research claims with source-linked supporting paraphrases, limitations and actual successful-read times. Distinguish model reasoning and unknown support from consulted pages. Preserve evidence in exports and history, label imported metadata honestly, and reject fabricated references or oversized results without replacing prior research.

Choose Quick, Standard or Deeper research with enforced time and tool-attempt ceilings. Review source-focus and recency preferences in the exact request before starting, and retain chosen settings with results. Preserve legacy unknown settings, cancellation, usage receipts and explicit retry; close late permission-approval races.

Review the exact context before starting isolated research. Exclude optional ancestors and other answers, inspect whole-record omissions and byte limits, and send only the reviewed snapshot. Changed saved sources require a fresh review. Preserve drafts, reject obsolete review tokens, and harden answer-check scope tracking.

Add read-only Diagnostics in Map settings with honest host, speech and helper prerequisites, explicit retries, and a strictly allowlisted support export. Preserve uncertain helper shutdown blockers, bound voice metadata inspection, and improve malformed release-metadata diagnostics.

Add Recovery to inspect validated saved versions, reopen damaged bound journeys as separate copies, retry saved reads and history, and dismiss recorded interruptions without replaying AI. Preserve drafts and receipts, report export visibility honestly, and safely quarantine only proven-dead writer locks.

Skip unchanged map transfers with conditional polling. Reconnect with bounded retries while preserving drafts and rejecting late responses. Keep private explanation freshness checks active, protect newer help results from older failed checks, and prevent old polls from overwriting accepted briefs.

Keep large maps responsive by mounting nearby cards and reusing stable layout geometry. Preserve focused controls, expanded editors, crossing connectors and full Outline access. Add near-limit culling, focus, resize and disposal regressions with separate pan/zoom benchmark counters.

Keep answer editors connected during polling, research and sibling updates, preserving typing, composition, caret and dictation. Reuse map and library rows, retain library keyboard focus, and refresh Outline only when visible. Add stable-editor regressions and separately labeled update performance counters.

Add a repeatable synthetic performance baseline for validated maps, context preparation, exports, layout, saved history writes and shipped panel DOM work. Reports include fixture fingerprints, bounded samples and explicit failures; native interaction checks remain manual.

Check a bounded summary of saved answers for possible tensions, unresolved choices and untested assumptions. Each suggestion links captured sources, shows omitted context, and can be dismissed or used to navigate. Changed source inputs make results stale; checking never edits answers.

Generate a bounded decision brief from saved journey context. Review uncertainty and source links, edit statements, then explicitly accept. Briefs preserve answers, track changed or unavailable sources, and export separately while staying in the complete native and Markdown record. History can recover earlier accepted briefs.

Pin up to 10 user constraints in journey guidance. Questions and research include complete mandatory context within a measured 128 KiB request budget, with whole-record omissions shown. Choose ancestor-only or additional-decision scope without starting AI. Pins stay in history and exports; stale results follow the sources actually sent.

Save answers while research runs. Independent changes survive completion, including saves from another canvas. Changing a source preserves your newer answer and discards stale research. Conflicting research is never silently replaced, and a new run waits for the prior helper to release.

Choose Understand, Decide, Design, Diagnose, or Challenge to guide future questions and research. A mode change is saved in guidance and history while earlier answers, research, and question explanations stay intact. The active mode appears above the map and in exports.

An expanded question now offers Rephrase, Give an example, and Explain terms. Model help uses bounded saved context in a separate tool-free helper; examples are illustrative. Explanations stay beside the question until you switch nodes or reload, without changing your question, answer or draft. Cancel help before cleaning an answer, or vice versa.

Suggested questions can explain the uncertainty they explore and why it matters to your goal. Review the explanation in the preview or expanded question; it remains tied to the original suggestion if wording or context changes. Legacy questions remain unchanged, and explanations appear in exports and history.

Clean My Answer proposes conservative edits to your current draft in a separate, tool-free Copilot helper. Review original and proposed text, Apply or Reject, and immediately Undo while the applied text is unchanged. Typing, dictation and navigation invalidate stale results; answer state stays yours and nothing submits automatically.

Dictate for up to ten minutes with ordered text appearing in recoverable local drafts. Stop finishes captured audio; Cancel keeps inserted text. Draft failures, model lag and resource limits stop capture visibly. Repeated words and Unicode are preserved, and an abandoned Record pointer press no longer reuses an old caret for keyboard activation.

Record hands-free beside an answer, then Stop to transcribe or Cancel to discard during loading, listening or transcription. Voice buttons share the existing shortcut lifecycle, preserve the answer caret and draft, and keep recording controls usable by keyboard. Leaving the answer workspace still cancels recording.

Pin up to three saved questions as optional references beside the active editor. Read their saved answer, state and review status, jump to a source, or remove a pin without changing the map. Private per-journey pins survive reopening, show unavailable sources after history restore, and require an explicit refresh to retry conflicting edits.

Suggest a missing direction in any branch, then let Copilot propose questions beneath it. Your original direction is saved and labeled as yours, survives failed or cancelled generation, and stays separate from answers and question counts. Review and accept generated questions before adding them.

Review generated questions before adding them. Select a subset, adjust wording or dismiss the unsaved preview. Accepted questions retain their original wording, and stale suggestions cannot overwrite changed context. New questions are highlighted without losing answer drafts or branch focus.

Map settings now save wheel zoom or pan, scroll sensitivity and motion preference across Explorer canvases. Ctrl/Command+scroll still zooms around the pointer, while scrolling inside a question stays native. System motion follows the OS; settings changes preserve maps, drafts and history.

Focus a question branch to show its root, ancestor path and subtree while hiding unrelated branches. Show whole map restores the wider view and keeps the selected question reachable. Focus preserves folds, drafts, research, exports and saved history.

Undo committed changes, preview and restore saved revisions, and keep named checkpoints. History preserves answers, states and research with bounded retention and interrupted-save recovery. Restores check competing writers and preserve local drafts, including state-only drafts for removed questions.

Collapse any branch to hide its descendants while keeping hidden-question and unresolved counts visible. Expand from the map or full outline; selecting a hidden question reveals its path. Folding preserves answers, drafts, research, exports and saved revisions.

Answers now distinguish Decided, Tentative, Assumption, Need evidence, Not relevant and Revisit later. Text and state save together only when you choose Save, with local draft recovery and conflict choices. Maps, outlines, exports and AI context preserve states; counts separate answered, resolved, deferred and unresolved questions.

Journeys can now include an optional objective and success criteria. Both guide future questions and isolated research, appear in JSON and Markdown exports, and can be revised without losing answer drafts. Finishing remains your decision; older journeys open with empty guidance.

Answer drafts now save locally as you type or dictate and recover across reopening and restart. Changed answers and conflicting canvases offer explicit recovery choices. Journey switches flush drafts, failures keep editor text, and saved answers remain separate from drafts, exports, and AI context.

Added a searchable exploration library with recent journeys, pinning, archive, and reopening across chats. Existing saves are discovered in place. Imports preserve prior journeys and offer explicit choices for duplicates. Switching protects unsaved answer and manual-question drafts and requires pending AI work to be cancelled.
Added release checks for package metadata, the lockfile, current README instructions, and release notes. Updated the installation checklist and documented a consistent version-bump procedure.

Fixed map dragging, accidental text selection, lost zoom on resize and stale refreshes hiding saved answers. Drag cards or question headings, wheel/pinch to zoom up to 300%, and reset with the percentage button. Improved keyboard recovery, large-map fitting, research scrolling, and draft scroll/selection/composition stability.

Research options now uses an isolated Copilot SDK researcher with dedicated instructions, web search, source checks, progress and cancellation. The main chat stays focused on questions. Apply recommendations, options or selected details to an editable draft with safe undo. Research usage receipts are retained locally.

Added Voice settings inside expanded nodes for microphone and downloaded-model selection. Dictation now shows real input levels, elapsed recording time, and distinct loading/transcription states. Choices persist separately from Copilot. README includes the voice architecture diagram and explanation.

Added Windows answer-box dictation using Copilot's configured shortcut and existing Nemotron English model. Includes listening status, push-to-talk/toggle, cancellation, and draft protection. Corrects v0.1.8's mistaken claim that native canvas dictation already worked. Requires compatible installed voice components and the default microphone.

Documented using Copilot's existing voice shortcut to dictate directly into an Explorer answer, confirmed in the installed desktop app. Recorded SDK research and current API limits. No new speech engine, shortcut, or recording behavior.

Integrated expanding nodes into the installed canvas, replacing the question sidebar. Answer, research, cancellation and follow-up controls now live inside the selected map node. Branches make room for the workspace, drafts survive async updates, and collapsed nodes preview saved answers.

Added a small version label at the bottom of Explorer, visible on the welcome screen and exploration map. The label uses the installed plugin package version. The expanding-node prototype also displays its version in the bottom bar.

Refined the selected expanding-node design with expansion in its branch, research below a preserved draft, answer previews on collapsed nodes, and connected follow-up navigation. The new prototype is the default for npm run prototype:layouts. The installed canvas is unchanged.

Added working attached-drawer and expanded-node prototypes to keep questions visibly connected to their answers and research. Compare shared drafts, sample research, and connected follow-ups with npm run prototype:layouts. The installed canvas is unchanged.

Added sourced research on alternatives to the question panel, comparing six products and interaction studies. Three concept sketches explore a local branch workspace, research cards, and a branch notebook. The installed plugin layout is unchanged.

Added four interactive question-placement prototypes: expanded node, floating card, bottom drawer, and focus overlay. Compare answer and research views with sample data using npm run prototype:layouts. The installed canvas layout is unchanged.
Documented the required version-and-publish workflow so each completed iteration is available to install from main under a new plugin version.
Explore an idea in a branching question map inside Copilot. Research alternatives, save your answers, and export a Markdown record plus a file you can reopen.
